archetypes.name: dyn-reference-split
archetypes.rationale: Checks active versus parked reference boundaries after the documentation split.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed shared references for plan fidelity. Confirm the active dialectic protocol no longer contains retired external-debater choreography while preserving clarifier grammar, thresholds, rotation, parser tolerance, and advisory disposition labels. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
